expected.finding: **[P2]** [archive-round.py:109](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/archive-round.py:109) now treats unsuccessful reviews as clean rounds. The workflow also posts comments for crashes, timeouts, and missing credentials; these contain no findings and now receive a policy stamp. They incorrectly count toward the policy’s evaluation period. Once archived, SHA deduplication also discards a successful retry’s findings. Require an explicit completed-review status before archiving an empty round.

**[P2]** [revise-improvement-policy.py:434](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py:434) overwrites evidence counts belonging to another keyword definition. When the current policy resolves a topic through `name@old`, its count is exposed under the plain topic name. Overlaying that onto `anchor_evidence` replaces the plain name’s distinct count while retaining its original definition. Evaluating another policy then uses mismatched evidence, potentially producing incorrect acceptance or rollback decisions. Resolve each candidate topic directly against the evidence-wide definitions and counts.
